lints.name: anon_security_definer_function_executable
lints.title: Public Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
lints.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable without signing in. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if it is not meant to be public.

findings.detail: Function `public.rls_auto_enable()` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/rls_auto_enable`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.submit_survey_response(p_survey_id uuid, p_anonymous_token text, p_answers jsonb)` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/submit_survey_response`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

lints.description: Detects if an index has never been used and may be a candidate for removal.

findings.detail: Index \`surveys_status_idx\` on table \`public.surveys\` has not been used
Index \`responses_submitted_at_idx\` on table \`public.responses\` has not been used

disposition.app_definer_rpcs: Intentional; public-key API authorization and validation tests passed. Retain required grants.
disposition.rls_auto_enable: Pre-existing event-trigger function; ordinary public RPC execution rejected with HTTP 400/0A000. Optional revoke of browser EXECUTE grants in a separate reviewed migration; not applied.
disposition.leaked_password_protection: Disabled. Supabase documentation says Pro plan or above. No paid upgrade or setting change made; use strong unique instructor password.
disposition.unused_indexes: Two informational findings remain after tests. Retain pending representative workload; no indexes removed.
